open_questions: Com_PumpSysEvents (0x08061b7c, merged name) returns an int that Cmd_Freeze_f uses as a millisecond clock; the merged name may be wrong or the function may be a clock helper with a misleading name.

CM_ReplaceBspLump can never write: its open-for-write call FS_ReturnZeroStub (0x080a0d54) is a stub returning 0 in this build. Confirm whether the write path is disabled on purpose; the lump writer and its checksum tail are dead.
g_084a74c0 is typed uint32[1024] in the merged symbols, but FS_BuildMissingIwdList passes its entries to I_strncat as C string pointers. The merge lane should retype it (const char *[1024]).

Com_PoolTouchAt (0x080ac5d8) is declared void in cod2_prototypes.h but tail-calls Com_PoolAt (0x080ac562), which returns unsigned char *; this chunk calls Com_PoolAt(offset) for the same result. The prototype should be corrected.
The symbol records for Cmd_Vstr_f and Cmd_List_f were tagged observed, but neither literal name appears in the binary (they are registered as 'vstr' and 'cmdlist'); this chunk tags them inferred.
dvar_s is recovered here with domainLo/domainHi at +0x14/+0x18 (Dvar_ValueInDomain) while chunk_028 names +0x14 enumCount; the two readings must be reconciled.
PC_Include copies includepath (64 bytes) and strncat's up to 0x40 bytes into a 64-byte path buffer; overlong include names overflow as in the binary.
Placeholder callees fn_080bcdbc, fn_080bce0e, fn_08062948, fn_08077090 (XAnim block alloc/free and their callbacks) need their owning chunk names and signatures.
